testimonials.title: Lawyers who want to run with less friction
testimonials.description: Placeholder references to show how Aurali credibility content could look in production.

one.quote: Aurali gave us a clear way to standardize processes without losing legal judgment. Today the team always knows what comes next in each case.
one.extended:
We used to rely on spreadsheets and scattered messages to know where each case stood. With Aurali, every file follows a clear flow: we know which document is missing, who needs to sign, and when to notify the client. That let us take on more cases without sacrificing the quality of our legal guidance.

What we value most is traceability: anyone on the team can open a case and immediately understand what stage it's in, without having to ask around. That's given us more confidence in front of clients and cut our response times by more than half.
one.author: Maria Fernanda Rojas

two.quote: Document generation stopped being a bottleneck. Now we review and approve instead of drafting everything from scratch.
two.extended:
Drafting documents used to take hours per case, especially when variables had to be adjusted by hand. Now we generate the document with the right information on the first try, and the legal team just reviews and approves. We cut delivery time in half.

We also stopped depending on one person to know the status of every document. The system automatically notifies whoever's responsible, so we can scale the number of cases we handle without growing the team at the same pace.
two.author: Sebastian Mejia

three.quote: We moved from scattered messages to a visible workflow for both the team and the client.
three.extended:
Working as an independent lawyer means every minute counts. Aurali gives me full visibility into every active process, automates client notifications, and lets me focus on legal strategy instead of chasing updates over chat.

I used to waste time scrolling through old conversations to remember where I'd left things with each client. Now everything is logged in the process itself, so I can pick up any case in seconds and respond in a much more professional way.
three.author: Valentina Pardo

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.disclaimer: This document is a base template and must be reviewed by a data-protection lawyer before it can be considered binding. It does not constitute legal advice.
privacyPolicy.intro: Aurali ("the Platform", "we") is legal-process automation software used by law firms in Colombia and their clients. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we process it, who we share it with, and how you can exercise your rights, in accordance with Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013 (Colombia's personal data protection regime).

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
sections.body: Your data is processed by the organization (law firm) managing your legal case through Aurali, which acts as the data controller, and by Aurali, which acts as the data processor in its role as the platform provider. You can reach us at hola@aurali.app for any inquiry about your data.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
sections.body: Identification and contact data (name, ID type and number, email, phone, address); case data, including financial and banking information related to the claim (bank, affected products, account of events); attached documents (receipts, statements, complaints) and digital signature where applicable; and technical usage data (audit logs, IP address, timestamps of actions taken).

sections.heading: 3. Purpose of processing
sections.body: We use your data to manage your legal case end to end, generate and send the corresponding documents, communicate with you about the status of your case, comply with legal and contractual obligations, and improve the security and functioning of the platform.

sections.heading: 4. Authorization
sections.body: By filling out your case form or using the platform, you grant prior, express and informed authorization for the processing of your personal data under this policy. You may revoke this authorization at any time, unless a legal or contractual duty prevents its immediate deletion.

sections.heading: 5. Processors and third parties
sections.body: To operate the platform we use infrastructure and service providers that act as data processors: Supabase (database and document storage), Vercel (application hosting), Google (document generation from Google Docs templates, when the organization connects its own Google account) and Anthropic (AI-assisted drafting of legal text fragments, based on case information). We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: 6. Use of Google user data
sections.body: Aurali's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. Aurali only accesses Google Docs explicitly selected by the organization as templates, solely to create temporary copies, substitute case variables and export them to PDF; temporary copies are automatically deleted once the process completes. We do not use this data for advertising nor share it with third parties unrelated to document generation.

sections.heading: 7. International data transfer
sections.body: Some of our providers (Supabase, Vercel, Google, Anthropic) process information on servers located outside Colombia. These transfers are carried out under the security standards required by applicable regulations, and providers are bound by contractual confidentiality and data-protection obligations.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
sections.body: As a data subject, you have the right to know, update, rectify and delete your information, and to revoke the authorization granted, under Law 1581 of 2012. To exercise these rights, write to hola@aurali.app stating your request; we will respond within the timeframes established by law.

sections.heading: 9. Security of information
sections.body: We apply organization-scoped access controls (case data is only visible to authorized members of the firm handling it), encryption in transit and at rest, and database-level security policies (Row Level Security). No system is 100% infallible, but we work actively to protect your information from unauthorized access.

sections.heading: 10. Data retention
sections.body: We retain your data for as long as your relationship with the organization managing your case lasts, plus any additional period required by legal, accounting or defense-related obligations. Once these periods elapse, data is securely deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy to reflect changes to the platform or to applicable regulations. Any relevant change will be published on this same page along with the last-updated date.

termsOfService.intro: These terms govern the use of Aurali ("the Platform"), legal-process automation software. By accessing or using the Platform, you accept these terms in full. If you do not agree, you must not use the service.

sections.heading: 1. Service description
sections.body: Aurali is a tool that lets law firms automate the management of legal cases: capturing case information, communicating with clients, generating legal documents, and tracking internal workflow.

sections.heading: 2. User accounts
sections.body: Access to the platform as a lawyer or organization member requires an authenticated account. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for all activity carried out from your account. Clients access specific forms via temporary links sent by the organization managing their case, without needing to create an account.

sections.heading: 3. Permitted use
sections.body: You must use the platform only for lawful purposes related to managing legal cases. It is prohibited to enter false information, attempt to access other organizations' data, interfere with the service's operation, or engage in any activity that violates the law.

sections.heading: 4. Generated documents and AI assistance
sections.body: The platform allows generating legal documents from templates and, in some cases, drafting text fragments with AI assistance based on case information. These documents are a starting point: it is the sole responsibility of the attorney in charge to review, validate and approve each document before using or sending it, as the Platform does not replace professional legal judgment or advice.

sections.heading: 5. Third-party integrations
sections.body: The platform may integrate with third-party services, such as Google Docs/Drive, to generate documents from templates connected by the organization. Use of these integrations is additionally subject to the relevant provider's terms of service and, in Google's case, to the Google API Services User Data Policy.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual property
sections.body: The software, the Aurali brand and its design are the property of their respective owners and are protected by applicable intellectual property laws. Case data and information managed on the platform belong to the organization and its clients, not to Aurali.

sections.heading: 7. Service availability
sections.body: We strive to keep the platform continuously available, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation. We may perform maintenance, updates, or feature changes at any time.

sections.heading: 8. Limitation of liability
sections.body: Aurali is not liable for legal decisions made based on documents generated by the platform, nor for indirect damages arising from use of the service. Professional responsibility for the legal case rests with the law firm handling it.

sections.heading: 9. Termination
sections.body: We may suspend or cancel access to the platform in case of breach of these terms or misuse of the service. Organizations may request deletion of their account and data at any time, subject to applicable legal retention obligations.

sections.heading: 10. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Colombia. Any dispute related to the use of the platform will be resolved before the competent courts of Colombia.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms to reflect changes to the service or to applicable regulations. Continued use of the platform after an update constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

sections.heading: 12. Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about these terms, write to us at hola@aurali.app.
